subject: Decision roster + contract routing plan for Nimble Retail POC
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@nimble-retail.com>, Jose Alvarez <jose.alvarez@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision roster + contract routing plan for Nimble Retail POC

Hi Elena and Jose — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep the POC on a May start: 

Call highlights (short):
- Goal: 6-week POC (product integration + 10K daily inference tokens) to validate latency and cost targets.
- Decision criteria: latency under 200ms tail, < $0.0015/token operational cost, SOC2 evidence and acceptable data retention terms.
- Economic buyer: Jose (confirmed on call). Procurement contact: procurement@nimble-retail.com.

Owners and routing (proposed):
1) NDA (mutual) — quick sign to share engineering artifacts. Redwood turn: 2 business days for first-pass redlines.
2) DPA — privacy & data handling; security evidence attached (SOC2, pen test summary). Redwood turn: 3 business days (aim to keep changes limited to section 5-7).
3) MSA — commercial/legal terms. Sequence: Legal redlines -> Procurement review -> Sign. Redwood first-pass: 3 business days; expect overall vendor review 7–10 business days.
4) SOW — scope and billing; to be finalized after MSA.

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_20270420.pdf (attached), POC-Scope-Checklist.xlsx (scope & success metrics). Also linking the HubSpot record and shared Drive folder: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/NR-2027-044

Ask: please confirm the decision roster below and average internal review SLAs so we can sequence redlines:
- Economic buyer: Jose Alvarez (final approvals)
- Procurement owner: procurement@nimble-retail.com
- Legal counsel / redline owner at Nimble: (please confirm name/email)
- Security/Privacy review: we propose Monica Patel (Redwood) to lead the evidence intake and DPA negotiation

If that aligns, we'll send the NDA for signature and drop a proposed MSA redline schedule.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(markus.klein@redwood.com)

Attachment: Redwood_NDA_20270420.pdf
Attachment: POC-Scope-Checklist.xlsx

From: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@nimble-retail.com>

Cc: Jose Alvarez <jose.alvarez@nimble-retail.com>, procurement@nimble-retail.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Decision roster + contract routing plan for Nimble Retail POC

Matt — thanks for the clear recap (and for the call). A few confirmations from our side: 

- Jose is the economic buyer and will sign commercial commitments.
- Procurement will drive the MSA queue (procurement@nimble-retail.com) and expects to own PO/payment terms.
- Our legal contact for initial redlines will be Lisa Gomez (lisa.gomez@nimble-retail.com) — she asked for an editable MSA and your standard DPA.
- Security will do a privacy/infosec intake; we will need SOC2 Type II and a brief summary of your encryption/retention approach.

On timing: procurement is moving quickly this quarter but legal has a two-week window for MSA review once they receive a redline. NDA can be first — we can sign within 3 business days on our side if it's reasonably mutual.

Please loop in Monica (security) and share the editable MSA and Redwood's DPA. Also, can you include a one-page summary of what will be considered PII vs pseudonymized telemetry for this POC? That will speed our DPA review.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Vargas
Head of Integrations | Nimble Retail
elena.vargas@nimble-retail.com

Subject: Re: Decision roster + contract routing plan for Nimble Retail POC — security/DPA intake

Hi Elena / Lisa — looping in early to accelerate the DPA and evidence collection. Thanks Markus for proposing the sequence. A few practical notes from security/ops: 

Security intake & documents we'll provide: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — available in Drive link.
- Pen test executive summary and remediation timeline.
- Data retention and encryption summary (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit).

Recommended redline sequencing (to minimize churn):
1) NDA (mutual) — sign to share artifacts. Redwood turnaround: 2 business days.
2) DPA — primary negotiation around data subjects, retention windows, and subprocessors. Redwood target: 3 business days for first-pass.
3) MSA — commercial and liability; Redwood will accept redlines on sections 4, 9-12 but asks to keep indemnity and liability caps within standard ranges. First-pass Redwood: 3 business days.
4) SOW — finalize scope and billing.

Target SLAs (Redwood): NDA 2bd | DPA 3bd | MSA 3bd for first-pass redlines. If Nimble requires substantive legal changes beyond commercial terms, please flag them early so we can align on decision owners (Jose as economic buyer).

Attached: POC-Scope-Checklist.xlsx (filled with security acceptance criteria). I'll also upload the DPA template to the shared Drive and highlight the privacy sections for quick review.

Happy to do a short redline sync with Lisa + procurement this week — propose Wed 10am PT.

— Monica Patel
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: POC-Scope-Checklist.xlsx

- We prefer monthly invoicing for POC work; please include an invoice line in the SOW for monthly consumption.
- Procurement expects to complete MSA review within ~10 business days after they receive your redline; we'll aim for that cadence.
- I'll be the final commercial signatory for the POC once legal and procurement approve the MSA and SOW.

Elena — we can schedule the redline sync Wed 10am PT. Markus / Monica — please share editable MSA and Redwood DPA in advance so Lisa can triage before the meeting.
